# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/labels/{id}

Get a single label by ID or name in an organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-084`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| id | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — api.Label

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Label ID |
| `name` | string | Label display name |
| `exclusive` | bool | Whether label is exclusive |
| `is_archived` | bool | Whether label is archived |
| `color` | string | Hex color without leading # |
| `description` | string | Label description |
| `url` | string | API URL for this label |

- **404** — Label does not exist in org or org not found
